title: Fire Separation Between Row Houses with More Than Two Secondary Suites
summary: Lets a Part 9 row house with more than two adjacent houses that have a secondary suite use a party wall with a 1 h fire-resistance rating instead of the firewall in Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2). You declare this in a signed Letter of Construction Intention filed with the permit application.

source.title: City of Edmonton, Policy B23-01 (30 July 2024)

groups.title: When this policy can be used
groups.plain: Check these first. If one does not fit your project, the policy does not cover it.

groups.title: The party wall
groups.plain: What the wall in place of the firewall must be.

groups.title: What goes in with the permit application
groups.plain: Drawings and the Letter of Construction Intention.

groups.title: What you declare in the Letter of Construction Intention
groups.plain: Each statement in the letter, which the owner or the owner's agent signs.

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: The building is a Part 9 row house with more than two adjacent houses that each have a secondary suite, on freehold or condominium lots.

source.label: Purpose
source.quote: for Part 9 row houses with more than two adjacent secondary suites, applicable to freehold or condominium lots.

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: The building is of residential occupancy.

source.label: Policy
source.quote: A party wall on a property line of a building of residential occupancy

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: The wall in place of the firewall is a party wall on a property line, and it separates each pair of adjacent houses with a secondary suite from the rest of the building.

source.label: Policy
source.quote: that separates any 2 adjacent houses with a secondary suite from the rest of the building need not be constructed as a firewall,
source.lead_in: A party wall on a property line of a building of residential occupancy

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: That party wall is built as a fire separation with a fire-resistance rating of at least 1 h.

source.label: Policy
source.quote: provided it is constructed as a fire separation having not less than a 1 h fire-resistance rating

conditions.subject: building
conditions.plain: The houses meet every other NBC(AE) requirement for building houses with a secondary suite.

source.label: Purpose
source.quote: provided the houses conform with all other NBC(AE) requirements for construction of houses with a secondary suite.

conditions.subject: permit_documents
conditions.plain: The drawings carry enough information to show the design follows this policy, including the related detail drawings.

source.label: Procedure 1.
source.quote: PROVIDE SUFFICIENT INFORMATION ON THE DRAWINGS to demonstrate conformance with this policy.

conditions.subject: permit_documents
conditions.plain: The Letter of Construction Intention is submitted with the permit application.

source.label: Procedure 2.
source.quote: Submit the LETTER OF CONSTRUCTION INTENTION, provided below, with the permit application.

conditions.subject: declaration
conditions.plain: The letter is printed (or typed), read and signed by the owner or the owner's authorized agent, with the project address or City file number filled in.

source.label: Letter of Construction Intention
source.quote: READ, SIGN AND SUBMIT THIS LETTER WITH THE BUILDING PERMIT APPLICATION

conditions.subject: declaration
conditions.plain: The person signing is the owner or the owner's authorized agent for the property.

source.label: Letter, first statement
source.quote: I am the owner or owner's authorized agent of the above-noted property;

conditions.subject: declaration
conditions.plain: The person signing has read Policy B23-01.

source.label: Letter, second statement
source.quote: by providing this letter, I confirm I have reviewed this 'Fire Separation Between Row Houses with More Than Two Secondary Suites' Policy B23-01 document;

conditions.subject: declaration
conditions.plain: The party-wall fire separations at this address will be built as the policy sets out, instead of asking for an alternative solution.

source.label: Letter, third statement
source.quote: will be constructed in accordance with this policy in lieu of requesting an alternative solution;

conditions.subject: declaration
conditions.plain: The policy, together with the plans, documents and details you submit, has enough detail to show conformance with Sentence 2.2.5.2. of Division C.

source.label: Letter, fourth statement
source.quote: contain sufficient details to demonstrate conformance with NBC2023(AE):Division C:2.2.5.2.
source.lead_in: I confirm that the policy document together with submitted plans, documents and details

conditions.subject: declaration
conditions.plain: You will tell the City if the construction intention changes during the project.

source.label: Letter, fourth statement
source.quote: I will notify the City of Edmonton if the approved construction intention is modified during the project.

source_notes.plain: In exceptional circumstances the officer may refuse to issue a permit that uses the policy, and tells the applicant why.
source_notes.quote: may refuse to issue a building permit that incorporates the policy;

source_notes.plain: The policy's opening line says the row house is constructed per 9.10.15. (spatial separation), while the rest of the policy is about the firewall in 9.10.11.2.(2). Ask the City if the reference matters for your design.
source_notes.quote: For a row house being constructed per NBC2023(AE):B:9.10.15. containing more than two adjacent houses

source_notes.plain: When the policy is used, not meeting its requirements is an offence.
source_notes.quote: When utilized, non-compliance with requirements of this policy is an offence.

source_notes.plain: The City updates the policy from time to time; check that you are using the most recent version.
source_notes.quote: Content subject to periodic update. Ensure use of the most recent version.
